posts.en:
dsh-harness-zh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3ca0dee24ab505438698.html
